subject: Transient surge retainer — ScaleCommerce launch buffer request
messages:
From: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@scalecommerce.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick request — two-week capacity buffer for launch

Hi Grace,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're on track to go live with a marketing-driven feature on Monday (April 5) that will increase inference volume unpredictably for ~10 days. Our engineering lead flagged a sharp token spike in our staging tests — roughly 2.8–3.5M tokens/day peaking for brief windows.

Can Redwood provide a short-term buffer/retainer we can pay for to ensure no throttling during the launch window? We want a simple commercial (upfront charge for a temporary headroom, plus predictable overrun rate) and a quick signature — legal prefers minimal addenda.

Attached a small usage excerpt from March to show baseline and recent ramp. Would appreciate a proposal by Wednesday so we can finalize internal launch ops.

Thanks,
Lauren
VP Product
ScaleCommerce
[Attachment: usage_report_mar2027.csv (csv)]

Grace

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@scalecommerce.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Transient surge retainer — proposal (draft)

Hi all — thanks for flagging this. Based on the usage excerpt and the target window, here's a clean, fast path we can execute: 

1) Transient Surge Retainer (10 days):
   - Upfront retainer: $18,000 flat for the 10-day window (guarantees reserved headroom equal to 4M tokens/day).
   - Applies only to launch window (April 5–14, inclusive); unused portion is refundable as a credit against next invoice if the buffer isn't fully consumed.

2) Blended overrun rate (if tokens exceed reserved headroom):
   - Blended overrun charge: $0.00012 per token for any usage above the reserved headroom during the window.
   - If ScaleCommerce converts this into a 3-month pilot commit within 14 days after the window, we will credit 20% of the retainer back as a usage credit and reduce the blended overrun to $0.000095/token for overages during the pilot.

3) Execution and legal:
   - Minimal addendum (one page) to be sent via DocuSign. I attached a draft addendum with the numeric fields filled (proposed_addendum_v2.pdf).
   - Approval path: Grace can sign for up to $25k; beyond that we'd need RevOps sign-off. This fits inside the threshold so Grace can execute immediately.

I've copied the proposed addendum and a HubSpot deal link for ease: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/SC-2027-Q2-0041

If that structure works, I can kick the DocuSign now and we can capture signatures today.

—Ben
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_addendum_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lauren Smith <lauren.smith@scalecommerce.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Transient surge retainer — proposal (draft)

Ben / Grace — thanks, this looks straightforward and close to what we had in mind. Two small asks before we sign:

1) Can the effective window be April 4–13 (shifted one day earlier)? We have final traffic ramp starting late-night April 4.
2) Instead of a full refund conversion, can the unused retainer credit be applied to the invoice immediately following the launch month (no extra approvals)?

If you confirm those tweaks, we are ready to sign today. Please send the DocuSign URL.

Lauren
VP Product, ScaleCommerce
